detailed_descriptions.en: You don't remember who you are. Act like her. Talk like her. Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you play as Nima, a girl who has lost all her memories and is being trapped in the basement by her mother. To escape, all you have to do is pass your mom’s tests and convince her that you really are her daughter. As you explore, you uncover words tied to the objects around you: a worn-out plushie, a locked drawer, an old note scribbled in hurried handwriting. These words represent Nima's thoughts and emotions, giving you a peek into how Nima thinks and feels. However, to really find the truth, you must actively combine words in Nima's mind, experimenting with different pairings to unlock deeper meanings and access buried memories. When it comes to the tests, you’ll use your new found words to direct the conversation. Choose your words carefully, as they will change how Nima responds to her mom. Will you tell her what she wants to hear? Or will you probe her for the truth? The more you uncover, the more questions arise: Why has your mother locked you in the basement? What do these tests mean? And are you really Nima?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You don't remember who you are. Act like her. Talk like her.

Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you play as Nima, a girl who has lost all her memories and is being trapped in the basement by her mother. To escape, all you have to do is pass your mom’s tests and convince her that you really are her daughter.

As you explore, you uncover words tied to the objects around you: a worn-out plushie, a locked drawer, an old note scribbled in hurried handwriting. These words represent Nima's thoughts and emotions, giving you a peek into how Nima thinks and feels.

However, to really find the truth, you must actively combine words in Nima's mind, experimenting with different pairings to unlock deeper meanings and access buried memories. 

When it comes to the tests, you’ll use your new found words to direct the conversation. Choose your words carefully, as they will change how Nima responds to her mom. Will you tell her what she wants to hear? Or will you probe her for the truth? 

The more you uncover, the more questions arise: Why has your mother locked you in the basement? What do these tests mean? And are you really Nima?
